02.amazon_product_title: ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 R2110 Dashboard Camera with Built-In Wi-Fi, SONY Exmor IMX323 Sensor, 1080P FHD 30FPS, WDR Night Vision, 145° Wide Angle, G-Sensor, 32GB Card

amazon_bullet_points: CLEAR 1080P RECORDING — Captures FHD 1080P video at 30FPS with 1920×1080 resolution for detailed road footage.
ENHANCED NIGHT VISIBILITY — SONY Exmor IMX323 sensor with Nighthawk Vision™ and WDR Superior Night Vision helps capture license plates, especially at night.
WIDE ROAD COVERAGE — 145° wide-angle view records up to 4 lanes of traffic for broader driving context.
BUILT-IN WI-FI APP ACCESS — Connects to DashCam Wi-Fi to review, download, and share videos through the Roav Dashcam app.
COLLISION-AWARE RECORDING — Gravity sensor monitors sudden stops or collisions and instantly starts recording when impact is detected.

04.amazon_product_description:
The ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 R2110 is a black vehicle dashboard camera designed to record clear driving footage for everyday commutes, road trips, and unexpected incidents. It captures FHD 1080P video at 30FPS with 1920×1080 resolution, helping provide detailed road footage when you need to review what happened on the road.

Built with a SONY Exmor IMX323 sensor, Nighthawk Vision™, and WDR Superior Night Vision, the DashCam C1 supports improved visibility in low-light conditions and helps capture license plates, especially at night. Its 145° wide-angle view records up to four lanes of traffic, giving broader context around your vehicle while driving.

For added safety awareness, the built-in Gravity Sensor monitors sudden stops or collisions and instantly starts recording when impact is detected. Built-in Wi-Fi works with the Roav Dashcam app, allowing you to connect to the camera, review footage, download videos, and share clips from your compatible mobile device.

The DashCam C1 includes an illuminated 2.4-inch screen, an F1.8 lens with six high-quality glass elements, a 470mAh Li-polymer battery, and operation support from 14°F to 149°F. The package includes the DashCam C1, Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner’s Manual.

customer_faq.question: What is this dash cam used for?
customer_faq.answer: The ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 is a vehicle dashboard camera designed to record road footage during daily driving, road trips, and unexpected incidents.

customer_faq.question: Does it record in high definition?
customer_faq.answer: Yes. It records FHD 1080P video at 30FPS with 1920×1080 resolution.

customer_faq.question: Can it record clearly at night?
customer_faq.answer: It includes a SONY Exmor IMX323 sensor, Nighthawk Vision™, and WDR Superior Night Vision to support improved low-light recording, including nighttime license plate capture.

customer_faq.question: How can I review or download videos from the camera?
customer_faq.answer: The dash cam has built-in Wi-Fi and works with the Roav Dashcam app, allowing you to review, download, and share videos from a compatible mobile device.

customer_faq.question: What comes in the box?
customer_faq.answer: The package includes the DashCam C1, Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual.

social_media_posts.caption_text: Unexpected stops and collisions can happen fast. The ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 uses a Gravity Sensor to monitor sudden stops or impacts and start recording when an incident is detected.
Need better road footage after dark? The DashCam C1 records in FHD 1080P at 30FPS and uses a SONY Exmor IMX323 sensor with WDR Superior Night Vision to support clearer low-light recording.
Road trip, commute, or city drive—reviewing your footage should be simple. Connect to the DashCam C1’s built-in Wi-Fi to review, download, and share videos through the Roav Dashcam app.

System/Role Context: Create a professional Amazon main hero product image for the ROAV by ANKER DASHCAM C1, model R2110, black. The image must answer the buyer question, “What is this product?” by clearly showing the vehicle dashboard camera and only its included accessories: DashCam C1, Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual.

Technical Specifications: Generate a 1080 × 1920 vertical 9:16 image on a pure white RGB 255,255,255 background. Use realistic studio product photography/rendering, soft studio lighting, minimal soft contact shadows, and controlled subtle reflections on the glossy lens cover and transparent display screen. The product grouping should fill approximately 85% of the frame while remaining fully visible.

Model Photographer's POV: Position the camera in a white studio at product height, slightly above the product centerline, looking toward the dashcam from a front-left three-quarter perspective. Aim the optical axis at the center of the dashcam body. Keep the dashcam sharply in focus as the dominant midground subject, with accessories arranged cleanly in the lower and side foreground/midground. Background remains empty white.

Preserve the dashcam’s tall compact proportions, moderate thickness, and slightly protruding lens.

Orientation & Spatial Sync: Show the display side angled toward the viewer while the camera lens projects forward along the real road-facing capture axis. The mounting bracket must sit physically above and connected to the main body. The display, lens, side circular panel, indicator, buttons, and orange accent must all share one consistent three-quarter perspective. Any visible reflection on the display or lens must match the white studio environment and not show unrelated scenery.

Scene Composition & Environmental Sync: Center the dashcam and make it the dominant object. Arrange the Anker 2-port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual neatly around the dashcam as secondary accessories, without hiding key device components. All objects should appear physically resting on the same invisible white studio surface with subtle contact shadows. Maintain clean spacing, no clutter, no lifestyle environment, and no background props.

Typography & Graphic Overlays: Do not add typography, feature callouts, icons, badges, banners, labels, decorative graphics, or overlay text. Do not add artificial product claims. Only natural markings physically present on the product or accessories may appear if they are visible and consistent with the supplied reference imagery.

Physical Constraints: The product and accessories must not float. Component placement must match the supplied geometry. The lens must point in its functional capture direction, and the display must face the viewer consistently with the camera angle. Do not invent exact physical body dimensions; use relative scale only. Use only the confirmed included accessories.

Negative Spatial Constraints: Do not copy the reference image as a flat sticker. Do not use impossible rotations, impossible support, contradictory perspective, invented components, extra accessories, extra ports, extra controls, extra lights, unverified labels, packaging, people, hands, vehicles, car interiors, road scenes, or decorative props. Do not show screen content that contradicts the visible white studio environment. Do not crop the dashcam or included accessories.

Amazon Compliance Constraints: Pure white RGB 255,255,255 background. Only product and included accessories. No text, icons, badges, or graphics. Product grouping fills approximately 85% of the frame. Entire product visible. Professional realistic appearance. Accurate representation of the ROAV by ANKER DASHCAM C1. - Download the Roav Dashcam app from the App Store or Google Play.

customer_faq.question: What is this dash cam used for?
customer_faq.answer: The ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 is a vehicle dashboard camera designed to record road footage during daily driving, road trips, and unexpected incidents.

customer_faq.question: Does it record in high definition?
customer_faq.answer: Yes. It records FHD 1080P video at 30FPS with 1920×1080 resolution.

customer_faq.question: Can it record clearly at night?
customer_faq.answer: It includes a SONY Exmor IMX323 sensor, Nighthawk Vision™, and WDR Superior Night Vision to support improved low-light recording, including nighttime license plate capture.

customer_faq.question: How can I review or download videos from the camera?
customer_faq.answer: The dash cam has built-in Wi-Fi and works with the Roav Dashcam app, allowing you to review, download, and share videos from a compatible mobile device.

customer_faq.question: What comes in the box?
customer_faq.answer: The package includes the DashCam C1, Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual.

social_media_posts.caption_text: Unexpected stops and collisions can happen fast. The ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 uses a Gravity Sensor to monitor sudden stops or impacts and start recording when an incident is detected.
Need better road footage after dark? The DashCam C1 records in FHD 1080P at 30FPS and uses a SONY Exmor IMX323 sensor with WDR Superior Night Vision to support clearer low-light recording.
Road trip, commute, or city drive—reviewing your footage should be simple. Connect to the DashCam C1’s built-in Wi-Fi to review, download, and share videos through the Roav Dashcam app.

The mounting bracket sits physically above the body and appears structurally connected. The lens, display, side panel, buttons, and indicator must align with the same coherent perspective. Use subtle contact shadows under all objects to show support.

The image must answer the buyer question, “What is this product?” by clearly showing the vehicle dashboard camera and only its included accessories: DashCam C1, Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual.

Technical Specifications: Generate a 1080 × 1920 vertical 9:16 image on a pure white RGB 255,255,255 background. Use realistic studio product photography/rendering, soft studio lighting, minimal soft contact shadows, and controlled subtle reflections on the glossy lens cover and transparent display screen. The product grouping should fill approximately 85% of the frame while remaining fully visible.

Model Photographer's POV: Position the camera in a white studio at product height, slightly above the product centerline, looking toward the dashcam from a front-left three-quarter perspective. Aim the optical axis at the center of the dashcam body. Keep the dashcam sharply in focus as the dominant midground subject, with accessories arranged cleanly in the lower and side foreground/midground. Background remains empty white.

Binding Geometry: Reconstruct the dashcam as a coherent 3D object, not as a flat pasted reference image. The device has a compact angular matte-black plastic body, a rectangular display screen centered on the rear-facing side and occupying most of that rear face, a protruding camera lens in the front lower section, cylindrical side supports, a top-center mounting bracket above the main body, a horizontal row of control buttons below the display screen, a side circular panel near the rear, a small orange/red status indicator embedded in that side circular panel, and a thin vertical orange accent near the upper side edge. Preserve the dashcam’s tall compact proportions, moderate thickness, and slightly protruding lens.

Orientation & Spatial Sync: Show the display side angled toward the viewer while the camera lens projects forward along the real road-facing capture axis. The mounting bracket must sit physically above and connected to the main body. The display, lens, side circular panel, indicator, buttons, and orange accent must all share one consistent three-quarter perspective. Any visible reflection on the display or lens must match the white studio environment and not show unrelated scenery.

Scene Composition & Environmental Sync: Center the dashcam and make it the dominant object. Arrange the Anker 2-port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual neatly around the dashcam as secondary accessories, without hiding key device components. All objects should appear physically resting on the same invisible white studio surface with subtle contact shadows. Maintain clean spacing, no clutter, no lifestyle environment, and no background props.

Typography & Graphic Overlays: Do not add typography, feature callouts, icons, badges, banners, labels, decorative graphics, or overlay text. Do not add artificial product claims. Only natural markings physically present on the product or accessories may appear if they are visible and consistent with the supplied reference imagery.

Physical Constraints: The product and accessories must not float. Component placement must match the supplied geometry. The lens must point in its functional capture direction, and the display must face the viewer consistently with the camera angle. Do not invent exact physical body dimensions; use relative scale only. Use only the confirmed included accessories.

Negative Spatial Constraints: Do not copy the reference image as a flat sticker. Do not use impossible rotations, impossible support, contradictory perspective, invented components, extra accessories, extra ports, extra controls, extra lights, unverified labels, packaging, people, hands, vehicles, car interiors, road scenes, or decorative props. Do not show screen content that contradicts the visible white studio environment. Do not crop the dashcam or included accessories.

Amazon Compliance Constraints: Pure white RGB 255,255,255 background. Only product and included accessories. No text, icons, badges, or graphics. Product grouping fills approximately 85% of the frame. Entire product visible. Professional realistic appearance. Accurate representation of the ROAV by ANKER DASHCAM C1. Vertical 1080 × 1920 composition.
